# MarketingSetu — AI, Digital Marketing & Growth Platform

> MarketingSetu is an all-in-one digital marketing, WhatsApp engagement, and digital presence platform for local businesses, enterprises, and retailers in India.

## Key Offerings & Services
- **WhatsApp Marketing & Automation**: Instant auto-replies, lead engagement, catalog sharing, template messaging.
- **Custom Business Landing Pages**: Instant mobile-first digital identity for small and medium businesses (SMBs).
- **Google Business Profile & Local SEO**: Local citation, map ranking, and discovery optimization.
- **Auto Call & SMS Follow-ups**: Automated enquiry capture and instant response sequences.
- **Analytics & Customer Dashboard**: Real-time traffic, contact leads, and click metrics.

## Service Regions (GEO)
- Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra, India
- Coverage: Pan-India (Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat, Delhi NCR, and across India)

## Pricing Plans
- Starter / Lite Plans starting at ₹1,999/year
- Growth & Custom Enterprise Plans
